name: Hidráulica y Acueductos — San Joaquín del Río
description: Bilingual 4-round simulation in which a small Colombian municipality (municipio de 6ª categoría, 9,200 inhabitants) must engineer an aqueduct and treatment upgrade under RAS 2017 — within a binding COP 2,400M envelope, a Superintendencia IRCA <5% deadline, and a CAR-monitored PSMV gap. Teams compute design flows, choose treatment + PTAR architecture, size distribution via Hazen-Williams, and defend the package to a sceptical concejo.
